duration: 1 year from the date of this Agreement, renewable by agreement of the parties.

financial_value.payment_terms: Annual rent, payable in 4 equal quarterly installments.

termination_clauses: Tenant must notify intent not to renew at least 60 days before expiry.
Early termination without lawful cause results in forfeiture of two months' rent.
penalty_clauses: Late payment penalty of 5% per month on any overdue installment.
governing_law: Laws of the United Arab Emirates; jurisdiction of the Dubai Courts.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
